pages.description: Mario and Luigi jump with joy inside a hidden cave in this printable coloring page, raising their fists above their heads beside a closed treasure chest. A star emblem decorates the chest's front below the latch, with pointed cave formations, curved walls, and a small rock around the brothers.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Walking Proudly In A Flower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi walk proudly through a flower field in this printable coloring page, taking long steps side by side among rows of rounded six-petaled blossoms. Large flowers fill the foreground below their shoes, while smaller blooms, simple leaves, rolling hills, and broad clouds repeat across the background.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Resting Happily In The Mushroom Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi rest happily in the Mushroom Kingdom in this printable coloring page, reclining on two giant mushroom caps with their feet lifted above the hillside. Mario places his hands behind his head while Luigi raises one glove, with smaller mushrooms, clouds, and castle towers around their seats.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Waving Happily In A Sky Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi wave happily in a sky level in this printable coloring page, standing on separate floating brick platforms with one open glove raised each. Small stars with oval eyes drift beside their caps, while a tiny flag-topped castle rests on a cloud high above the layered cloud banks.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Celebrating Adventure In A Cave Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi celebrate an adventure in a cave level in this printable coloring page, jumping with raised arms as Luigi holds a large Super Mushroom overhead. A closed treasure chest sits behind them, while three smiling bats, hanging cave formations, and a narrow block platform surround their lifted feet.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Celebrating Happily Near A Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi celebrate happily near a fortress in this printable coloring page, raising both fists as they jump together in front of the stone castle entrance. A mushroom-emblem flag flies between pointed towers above a barred gate, with rolling hills, grass tufts, and fluffy clouds behind the brothers.

pages.title: Mario Luigi Posing Proudly In A Cave Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Luigi pose proudly in a cave level in this printable coloring page, with Mario raising a fist while Luigi touches his cap and props one foot on a rock. Small mushrooms grow on narrow cave ledges, while hanging stalactites, pointed formations, loose stones, and winding waterlines surround the pair.
